request.description:
**Deprecated:** prefer `GET /assets/generations` (all types, paginated, same source filter). This endpoint continues to work; no removal is scheduled.
List 3D models you previously generated through the API, most recent first. This is a free read-only history lookup (no credits, no generation); it does not create anything. Pass an optional request_id query parameter to return only the results tagged with that id when you originally called create3DModel. Requires an API key (user scope).

item.name: Ludo.ai Convert a 2D image to a 3D model

request.description: Convert a 2D image into a textured 3D GLB model with configurable PBR textures, polygon count, and texture resolution. Processing takes 60 to 120 seconds. Returns the GLB model URL and four snapshot images from different angles. Costs 3 credits per model.
